source: Nebraska DOR 2026 withholding formula (W-4N basis, reproduced in NFC bulletin NFC-26-1774374744, eff. pay period 04-2026): withholding allowance $2,440/yr each; tables 2.26%–4.60% (LB 754 rate step-down).
